topic: Authorizing a Friend to Pick Up a Kid

script.title: THE PICKUP CODE WORD
script.scene_zh: 學務處 · 更換接送人
script.story_hook: A mom asks the office to add a friend.
script.intro_zh: 一位媽媽請學校櫃檯把朋友加進接送名單。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we update a school pickup list. Listen for ID and permission phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們到學校櫃檯更換接送名單。留意證件與授權的說法。
script.outro: The list is set, the code word works. Safe travels!
script.outro_zh: 名單辦好了，暗號也設定了。一路順風！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat the pickup phrases.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們逐句跟讀接送相關說法。
script.char_a_description: a young mother in her early thirties with dark straight brown hair in a low ponytail, wearing a denim jacket over a gray tee, black jeans and a small shoulder bag, slim build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful older woman in her sixties with short curly gray hair and round glasses, wearing a teal cardigan over a printed blouse and beige slacks, stocky build, warm smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I called earlier about pickup.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ kɔld ˈɜɹli əˈbaʊt pɪkˈʌp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我早上打過電話，談接孩子的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the Tuesday favor? Have a seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈtuzˌdeɪ ˈfeɪvɚ hæv ə sit/
dialogue.zh: 想起來了，是週二麻煩朋友接送的事。請坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend Gaby can take Milo home.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd ˈɡæbi kæn teɪk ˈmiloʊ hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我的朋友嘉比會帶米羅回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. I need her full name first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪ nid hɜɹ fʊl neɪm fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 好，我先需要她的全名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gabriela Reyes. We all call her Gaby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɡæbɾiˈɛlə ˈɹeɪəz wi ɔl kɔl hɚ ˈɡæbi/
dialogue.zh: 嘉百列‧雷耶斯。我們都叫她嘉比。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Does she have photo ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt dʌz ʃi hæv ˈfoʊˌtoʊ ˌaɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。她有附照片的證件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, a driver's license. Why do you ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə ˈdɹaɪvɚz ˈlaɪsəns waɪ du ju æsk/
dialogue.zh: 有駕照。為什麼要問這個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We check it at the door. Rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tʃɛk ɪt æt ðə dɔɹ ɹulz/
dialogue.zh: 接送時要在門口核對證件。這是規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Makes sense. Um, what else do you need?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns ʌm wʌt ɛls du ju nid/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。呃，還需要什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A backup number, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbækˌʌp ˈnʌmbɚ dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 一支備用電話，以防聯絡不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try her cell: five-five-five, two-two-nine-four.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹaɪ hɚ sɛl faɪv faɪv faɪv tu tu naɪn fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 打她的手機：五四五，二二九四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. Now the fun part — a code word.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs naʊ ðə fʌn pɑɹt ə koʊd wɜɹd/
dialogue.zh: 好了。現在是有趣的部分——暗號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A code word? Like spy stuff?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə koʊd wɜɹd laɪk spaɪ stʌf/
dialogue.zh: 暗號？像間諜在用的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Pick one Milo knows by heart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli pɪk wʌn ˈmiloʊ noʊz baɪ hɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。選一個米羅早就記熟的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, they say Purple Turtle every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðeɪ seɪ ˈpɜɹpəl ˈtɜɹtəl ˈɛvɹi naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，他們每晚睡覺前都會說「紫烏龜」。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Purple Turtle? Perfect. I'll write it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹpəl ˈtɜɹtəl pɜɹˈfɛkt aɪl ɹaɪt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 紫烏龜？太好了，我把它寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they really say it at the gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ ˈɹiəli seɪ ɪt æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他們真的要在門口說出暗號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She shows ID, we check, Milo leaves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ʃoʊz ˌaɪˈdi wi tʃɛk ˈmiloʊ liːvz/
dialogue.zh: 她出示證件，我們核對，米羅就跟著走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's cute, and smart, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts kjut ænd smɑɹt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，這方法又貼心又聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We've had close calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /wiːv hæd kloʊs kɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 我們發生過差點出事的情況。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh. Like strangers at dismissal?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ laɪk ˈstreɪndʐɚz æt dɪsˈmɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 噢，像放學時有陌生人來接？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once. We stopped it with this list.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns wi stɑpt ɪt wɪθ ðɪs lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 有一次，就是靠這份名單擋下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I get it now. This is serious.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ ɡɛt ɪt naʊ ðɪs ɪz ˈsɪɹiəs/
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在懂了，這是很嚴肅的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more: may I see your ID, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ meɪ aɪ si jʊɹ ˌaɪˈdi pliz/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事：可以看您的證件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, here's my license. Why mine, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ hɪɹz maɪ ˈlaɪsəns waɪ maɪn tuː/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這是我的駕照。為什麼也要查我的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New names need a parent's signature. Yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu neɪmz nid ə ˈpɛɹənts ˌsɪɡnəˈtʃɚ jʊɹz/
dialogue.zh: 新名字需要家長簽名。就是您的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, right. Do I sign something?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɹaɪt du aɪ saɪn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，對喔。是要簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This yellow slip, bottom line, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈjɛloʊ slɪp ˈbɑtəm laɪn pliz/
dialogue.zh: 在這張黃色單據的底線簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Um, does Gaby need to bring anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʌm dʌz ˈɡæbi nid tə brɪŋ ˈɛnɪθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了。呃，嘉比當天需要帶什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her ID, and the code word. That's it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜɹ ˌaɪˈdi ænd ðə koʊd wɜɹd ðæts ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 她的證件，加上暗號，這樣就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy. When does this start working?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizɪ wɛn dʌz ðɪs stɑɹt ˈwɜɹkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不難。那什麼時候會生效？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, after the four o'clock list prints.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈæftɚ ðə fɔɹ əˈklɑk lɪst prɪnts/
dialogue.zh: 明天，下午四點接送名單列印之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's the problem—
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæts ðə ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，問題就在這裡——

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gaby picks him up today, three o'clock!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡæbi pɪks hɪməp təˈdeɪ θɹi əˈklɑk/
dialogue.zh: 嘉比今天三點就要接他！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today? The list still shows only you.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ðə lɪst stɪl ʃoʊz ˈoʊnli juː/
dialogue.zh: 今天？名單上目前還是只有你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know! My flight's at six. I can't make it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ maɪ flaits æt siks aɪ kænt meɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我知道！我的飛機六點起飛，真的趕不回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, don't panic yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ doʊnt ˈpænɪk jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 好，先別緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there any way? Um, a paper note?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛɹ ɛni weɪ ʌm ə ˈpeɪpɚ noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 還有別的辦法嗎？呃，書面便條可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll call the gate, and post a photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl kɔl ðə ɡeɪt ænd poʊst ə ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我打電話交代門口，再把照片貼上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her photo! You can print one?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜɹ ˈfoʊtoʊ ju kæn prɪnt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 她的照片！你們可以列印嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it to the school email now.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ɪt tə ðə skul ˈimel naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在就把照片傳到學校信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On it. Gaby sent me a selfie yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ɪt ˈɡæbi sɛnt mi ə ˈsɛlfi ˈjɛstɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 馬上辦。嘉比昨天傳了一張自拍照給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Attach it, I'll print it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt əˈtætʃ ɪt aɪl prɪnt ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，把它附加進來，我來列印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent. Oh wait—her hair is blue today.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt oʊ weɪt hɜɹ hɛɹ ɪz blu təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 傳了。等等，她今天頭髮染成藍色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue? Does she look different?
dialogue.phonetic: /bluː dʌz ʃi lʊk ˈdɪfɚənt/
dialogue.zh: 藍色？她現在看起來很不一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really different. The gate lady might stare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹiəli ˈdɪfɚənt ðə ɡeɪt ˈleɪˌdi maɪt stɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 差很多。管理門口的小姐一定會多看了幾眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll note the hair in the call. Good catch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl noʊt ðə hɛɹ ɪn ðə kɔl ɡʊd kætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我會用電話交代髮色。幸好你提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Should I say sorry to Gaby?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ʃʊd aɪ seɪ ˈsɑɹi tə ˈɡæbi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！我要先跟嘉比說聲抱歉麻煩她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No. Tell her: ID, code word, smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tɛl hɜɹ ˌaɪˈdi koʊd wɜɹd smaɪl/
dialogue.zh: 不用。只要告訴她：帶證件、說暗號、微笑就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha. Um, one last question.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʌm wʌn læst ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 哈。呃，最後一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, go ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɡoʊ əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 好，你說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else is on the list right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɛls ɪz ɑn ðə lɪst ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在名單上還有誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You, plus Mr. Alvarez on Fridays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju plʌs ˈmɪstɚ ælˈvɛɹɛz ɑn ˈfɹaɪdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 有您，還有每週五的阿爾法雷斯先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's my dad. He's retired now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ dæd hiːz ɹɪˈtaɪɹd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那是我爸爸，他現在退休了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I knew it! Same warm smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ njud ɪt seɪm wɔɹm smaɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我就知道！你們兩個笑起來一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, he smiles more than I do.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hi smaɪlz mɔɹ ðæn aɪ duː/
dialogue.zh: 哈，他比我愛笑多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set. Check your email for a copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt tʃɛk jʊɹ ˈimel fɔɹ ə ˈkɑpɪ/
dialogue.zh: 都辦好了。查看信箱，副本在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It just pinged. You're a lifesaver.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʒʌst pɪŋd jʊɹ ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 剛剛叮一聲到了。你今天真的救了我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe flight. Milo leaves at three, no worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf flait ˈmiloʊ liːvz æt θɹi noʊ ˈwɜɹi/
dialogue.zh: 一路順風。米羅三點就有人接，別擔心。

script.youtube_description:
朋友臨時答應幫你接孩子，學校櫃檯該怎麼說、要帶什麼？這一集用60句自然英文，帶你走一遍完整的接送授權流程：登記親友全名、確認附照片的證件、留下備用電話、設定親子暗號，還有系統來不及更新時的急轉彎。

你會聽到：
- 登記與核對：「Does she have photo ID?」
- 暗號的說法：「Pick one Milo knows by heart.」
- 生效時間的確認：「When does this start working?」
- 臨時變通的說法：「I'll call the gate, and post a photo.」

這些短句在國外的學校辦事處裡天天使用，聽熟就能開口。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先聽完整段對話，再一句一句模仿，讓句子變成口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

祝你每一次委託接送，都安心順利。

script.youtube_description_en:
A friend just agreed to pick up your kid, but the school needs everything official. In 60 short A2 lines you hear a mom and the front office clerk complete the whole pickup authorization: full name, photo ID rules, an emergency phone, and a family code word. Then comes the twist: the pickup is TODAY, before the list updates.

You will learn permission phrases, ID and pickup-list vocabulary, code word questions, and how staff solve a same-day switch by email and phone. Real American speech with contractions, fillers, and polite hedging.

The back half is line-by-line listening plus shadowing practice. No memorizing needed—just listen until it sticks.

Made for A2 learners and parents living abroad.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new daily-life English listening video every week.

script.thumbnail_action: signing a yellow permission slip at the desk
